## Scope note

Run of 281 test cases against supplier TravelportNdc, credentialsSelector UAE, staging stg-ne-3 (V1 and V2). Sources: TravelportNdc_Void_TestCases.csv (53), TestCases_V1.csv (59), TestCases_V2.csv (57 in scope), and 112 new rows in TravelportNdc_UAE_Regression_TestCases.csv (route search and booking for QR, EK, RJ and SV, all 115 valid passenger combinations, passenger negatives, round trips, hold-expiry and Book-without-AddPassenger regressions). Excluded as instructed: Ancillary and SeatMap (V2 flows 37-72 and 85-120 and their NEG rows, TC-ANCILLARY-*, TC-SEATMAP-*, TC-FARECHECK-*). Flows written for other suppliers (Emirates, EgyptAir, AirCairo, SabreNDC, FlyNas, FlyCham...) were re-targeted to TravelportNdc/UAE; V1 flows ran with 2 ADT + 2 CHD + 2 INF, V2 flows with 1 ADT + 1 CHD + 1 INF, Void flows with 1 ADT. Bundle-only flows (V1 13-24, V2 31-36 and 79-84, with NEG rows, TC-BUNDLE-VAL-01) are BLOCKED because TravelportNdc has no bundles. Blocked for other reasons: post-expiry cases (the QR hold lasts until 2026-11-04), VoidNotAllowed cases (no booking reports it), requestUrl and other-supplier cases, TC-VOIDTPN-BIZ-01 (needs a previous-day ticket), TC-VOIDTPN-BND-02 (midnight), TC-VOIDTPN-REG-01 (SabreNdc out of scope). "Both" rows pass only if V1 and V2 both meet the expectation. Route coverage: every route that returned an offer for a carrier in a 318-search sweep of 159 candidate routes (QR 138, EK 91, RJ 77 routes) was searched on V1 and V2; 10 routes per carrier were booked end to end on both versions. SV has no inventory on TravelportNdc/UAE. Test-design corrections made during the run: the passenger-combination set was rebuilt to ADT+CHD+INF <= 9 (SPEC 2.1) after the first pass counted only ADT+CHD; a number of cases were re-run after checks that were too strict were corrected (V2 Upselling selectedOffer check, stale-ID error-code name, hold-path voidCapability added to BIZ-05, age/type rule tightened in PAX-BNEG-05/06). 282 TravelportNdc bookings and holds were created and all were voided or cancelled (262 voided, 20 cancelled); 15 orphan supplier GDS PNRs from failed Books cannot be cancelled through the API (see Cleanup).

### TC-TPNREG-BOOK-01 — FAIL

- **Test Case:** [TravelportNdc][Book][Request] Validate V2 Book without a preceding AddPassenger returns a validation error and not HTTP 500.
- **Category:** Negative
- **Endpoint Name:** V2 Book without AddPassenger
- **Request:** V2 Search &gt; V2 FareConfirm &gt; V2 Book
- **Response:** V2 Search 200 offers 5 || V2 FareConfirm 200 {"responseId":"a2beb93e-6cf2-4e6c-84ae-b48b518482bb","supplier":"TravelportNdc","journeys":{"f1":{"origin":"DO || V2 Book 500 ServerError Unknown error occured. Please keep the transaction id as a reference. | 
- **Expected:** A 4xx standard validation envelope stating passenger details are missing; no 500; no booking created.
- **Actual:** 1 of 1 checks failed: Book without AddPassenger rejected with a 4xx validation error (not 500) [500 ServerError Unknown error occured. Please keep the transaction id as a reference. | ]
- **Status:** FAIL
- **Evidence:** FAIL Book without AddPassenger rejected with a 4xx validation error (not 500) (500 ServerError Unknown error occured. Please keep the transaction id as a reference. | )

## Findings

### Defects

- **[TC-VOIDTPN-BIZ-05] BUG-01 (occurrence 3, not new) &mdash; voidCapability is missing from Hold, PnrReprice (FareConfirmAfterHold) and held-Retrieve responses on V1 and V2, while Book, BookAfterHold and ticketed Retrieve return FullVoidOnlyAllowed** Field: `voidCapability`. Expected: "voidCapability": "FullVoidOnlyAllowed" (or the supplier value) on every booking response that can later be voided. **History:** First observed Round 1 (2026-10-26, 20261026-105925_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2); reproduced Round 2 (2026-10-27, stg-ne-5, 20261027-061359_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2-Round2); reproduced again 2026-11-01 on stg-ne-3: Hold and PnrReprice carried voidCapability in 0 of 25 responses on V1 and V2 **Impact:** A caller cannot read void eligibility from a held booking or after repricing; it only appears once the booking is ticketed Evidence: Hold 0/25, PnrReprice 0/25 (this run, all hold flows); V1 and V2 [hold path] check in TC-VOIDTPN-BIZ-05
- **[TC-VOIDTPN-BND-01] BUG-03 (occurrence 3, not new) &mdash; Void treats bookingToken as a presence check only: a 1000-character token, an upper-cased token or another booking's token still voids the booking on V1 and V2** Field: `bookingToken`. Expected: 400/409 standard envelope, booking left ticketed. **History:** First observed Round 1 (2026-10-26, 20261026-105925_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2); reproduced Round 2 (2026-10-27, stg-ne-5, 20261027-061359_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2-Round2); reproduced again 2026-11-01 **Impact:** The token does not bind the Void to the booking; any PNR holder can void with an arbitrary token Evidence: BND01-tok-1000 and BND01-tok-upper voided the booking on V1 and V2; NEG-02 mixed token and NEGHOP5/NEGHOP6 stale-token voided the booking on V1 and V2; BND01-pnr-lower also voided (case-insensitive pnr)
- **[TC-VOIDTPN-VAL-04] BUG-04 (occurrence 3, not new) &mdash; surName is ignored by Void on V1 and V2: a surname that matches no passenger, no surname at all, or an injection string still voids the booking** Field: `surName`. Expected: 400/409 standard envelope, e.g. "surName does not match any passenger", booking left ticketed. **History:** First observed Round 1 (2026-10-26, 20261026-105925_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2); reproduced Round 2 (2026-10-27, stg-ne-5, 20261027-061359_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2-Round2); reproduced again 2026-11-01 **Impact:** Anyone holding a PNR/gdsPNR can void a ticket without knowing the passenger surname Evidence: VAL04-wrong and VAL04-omit voided on V1 and V2; SEC04-sql, SEC04-xss and SEC04-long (surName) voided on V1 and V2
- **[TC-VOIDTPN-BIZ-06] BUG-09 (occurrence 3, not new) &mdash; voidTickets is ignored: a subset, a fabricated ticket number or another booking's ticket number voids every ticket on the PNR (V1 and V2); voidTickets omitted also voids all** Field: `voidTickets`. Expected: Either only the listed ticket is voided, or a 4xx stating partial void is unsupported; fabricated/foreign numbers rejected. **History:** First observed Round 1 (2026-10-26, 20261026-105925_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2); reproduced Round 2 (2026-10-27, stg-ne-5, 20261027-061359_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2-Round2); reproduced again 2026-11-01 **Impact:** A caller cannot void one passenger; a wrong ticket list silently voids the whole booking Evidence: BIZ-06: voidedTickets 3, still Booked 0/3 on V1 and V2; NEG-03 fabricated and foreign ticket both voided on V1 and V2; VAL06-omit voided
- **[TC-VOIDTPN-VAL-07] BUG-05 (occurrence 3, not new) &mdash; Void failures expose raw Travelport payloads (OriginalSupplierRequest / OriginalSupplierResponse) and internal .NET type names on V1 and V2** Field: `Context[].Value / OriginalSupplierRequest / OriginalSupplierResponse`. Expected: Integration-defined fields only, no raw supplier payload and no DTO type names. **History:** First observed Round 1 (2026-10-26, 20261026-105925_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2); reproduced Round 2 (2026-10-27, stg-ne-5, 20261027-061359_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2-Round2); reproduced again 2026-11-01 **Impact:** Leaks supplier request/response structure and internal type names to every API consumer Evidence: 7 of 29 sampled failures per version leak (SEC03a-sabre, SEC03b-EGY, second Void, Void on a cancelled hold and others); 9 of 29 use the camelCase envelope
- **[TC-VOIDTPN-VAL-10] BUG-06 (occurrence 3, not new) &mdash; V2 Void returns passengersVoidedAncillaries: null for a booking without ancillaries (emdTickets is {})** Field: `passengersVoidedAncillaries`. Expected: "passengersVoidedAncillaries": {}. **History:** First observed Round 1 (2026-10-26, 20261026-105925_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2); reproduced Round 2 (2026-10-27, stg-ne-5, 20261027-061359_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2-Round2); reproduced again 2026-11-01 **Impact:** Consumers must null-check a field documented as a collection Evidence: V2 Void success body in TC-VOIDTPN-POS-02
- **[TC-VOIDTPN-NEG-01] BUG-10 (occurrence 3, not new) &mdash; Void of a non-existent PNR returns 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 with the raw Travelport reply on V1 and V2 instead of a mapped "booking not found" error** Field: `ErrorCode`. Expected: 404/409 with a mapped ErrorCode and no raw supplier payload. **History:** First observed Round 1 (2026-10-26, 20261026-105925_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2); reproduced Round 2 (2026-10-27, stg-ne-5, 20261027-061359_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2-Round2); reproduced again 2026-11-01 **Impact:** The unknown-PNR condition cannot be told apart from other Z9999 supplier errors Evidence: V1 and V2 Void with pnr ZZZZZZ: ErrorCode NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999, OriginalSupplierRequest/Response present
- **[TC-VOIDTPN-NEG-05] BUG-11 (occurrence 3, not new) &mdash; Void errors use two envelopes: PascalCase {Status, ErrorCode NDC-INT-TEC-A0001} and camelCase {status, errorCode 1001}; unmapped Z9999 is used for several different conditions** Field: `error envelope (ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, casing)`. Expected: One envelope and one code family per condition. **History:** First observed Round 1 (2026-10-26, 20261026-105925_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2); reproduced Round 2 (2026-10-27, stg-ne-5, 20261027-061359_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2-Round2); reproduced again 2026-11-01 **Impact:** Consumers need two parsers and cannot map Z9999 to a cause Evidence: Mapping table (ErrorCode status: count): NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 400: 18; 1001 400: 18; AuthenticationError 401: 6; NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 409: 8 (incl. Void on a held booking and unknown PNR); NDC-INT-BYP-A0003 409: 8; 18 of 58 failures use the camelCase envelope
- **[TC-TPNREG-BOOK-01] BUG-12 (occurrence 3, not new) &mdash; V2 Book sent without a preceding AddPassenger returns HTTP 500 ServerError instead of a validation error** Field: `V2 Book (no passengersList)`. Expected: 400 standard validation envelope stating passenger details are missing. **History:** First observed Round 1 (2026-10-26, 20261026-105925_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2); reproduced Round 2 (2026-10-27, stg-ne-5, 20261027-061359_TravelportNdc-Void-UAE-V1V2-Round2); reproduced again 2026-11-01 by TC-TPNREG-BOOK-01 **Impact:** A client that skips AddPassenger gets an opaque 500 with no cause Evidence: V2 Search &gt; FareConfirm &gt; Book with the FareConfirm ids: 500 ServerError "Unknown error occured. Please keep the transaction id as a reference."
- **[TC-VOIDTPN-SEC-03] BUG-13 (occurrence 2, not new) &mdash; Two different bookings created in parallel were returned the same bookingToken** Field: `bookingToken`. Expected: A unique bookingToken per booking. **History:** First observed Round 2 (2026-10-27, 2 of 102 bookings); reproduced 2026-11-01: 1 pair in 278 bookings **Impact:** A Void/Retrieve/Cancel keyed on the token can act on the wrong booking Evidence: pnr 82GJ34 (V2, gdsPNR JJ0R3R) and pnr 82FU8G (V1, gdsPNR JJ0R3Q) both returned bookingToken 52ee7637-d9af-4056-a7b7-5cba7188a014 (prepared in parallel for TC-VOIDTPN-SEC-03)
- **[FLOW-V1-07] BUG-15 (occurrence 2, not new) &mdash; V1 Upselling returns upsellOffers[] and no selectedOffer, so it is not the documented drop-in replacement for FareConfirm** Field: `selectedOffer`. Expected: A selectedOffer (or documented tier selection) usable as the FareConfirm output. **History:** First recorded in other series; confirmed Round 2 (FLOW-V1-09-TPN); reproduced 2026-11-01 in every V1 Upselling flow **Impact:** The caller must pick a tier by hand; V1 flows 7-12 fail on this check Evidence: FLOW-V1-07 to FLOW-V1-12, FLOW-V1-09-TPN, FLOW-V1-11-TPN: response keys responseId, supplier, journeys, flightSegments, priceClasses, baggageDetails, upsellOffers
- **[TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-200] BUG-16 (new) &mdash; V2 Book returns per-passenger-type amounts that are already multiplied by the passenger count, while V1 Book, FareConfirm and Search return per-passenger amounts; the SPEC 2.1 reconciliation fails on V2 Book for any party with two or more passengers of a type** Field: `selectedOffer.passengerFareBreakdown[].paxBaseAmount / paxTotalTaxAmount (V2 Book)`. Expected: ADT paxBaseAmount 690 / tax 415 per passenger (as in V2 FareConfirm) with totalAmount 2210 for 2 ADT. **Impact:** A consumer applying base x count double counts: for 2 ADT it computes 4420 against a real total of 2210 (and 8 times too much for 9 ADT) Evidence: 2 ADT QR DOH-DXB: V2 Book breakdown base 1380 / tax 830 per ADT entry vs FareConfirm 690 / 415; totalAmount 2210. 23 test cases fail only on V2 Book price reconciliation: TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-202, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-200, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-211, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-300, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-222, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-400, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-EK-222, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-333, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-500, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-600, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-440, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-700, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-RJ-222, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-404, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-800, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-180, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-900, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-270, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-540, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-414, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-210, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-504, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BOOK-QR-252. V1 Book reconciles in every case
- **[TC-TPNREG-RTE-BOOK-EK-06] BUG-17 (new) &mdash; Emirates (EK) Book responses intermittently omit voidCapability on V1 and V2, while Qatar Airways and Royal Jordanian Book responses always carry FullVoidOnlyAllowed** Field: `voidCapability (Book)`. Expected: "voidCapability": "FullVoidOnlyAllowed" on every ticketed Book. **Impact:** Void eligibility cannot be read for some EK bookings; clients cannot rely on the flag Evidence: Book voidCapability present: QR V1 50/50, V2 49/49; RJ V1 14/14, V2 14/14; EK V1 9/12, V2 11/13 (e.g. EK DXB-JFK V1 and V2 both absent)
- **[TC-TPNREG-RTE-BOOK-EK-10] BUG-18 (new) &mdash; Emirates (EK) Book intermittently fails with 409 NDC-INT-BYP-A0001 "requested flight or class is no longer available" for an offer just returned by Search and FareConfirm; the message says the booking is "still in the hold stage" with a GDS PNR but PNR N/A, leaving an orphan supplier PNR that the API cannot cancel, and the body carries the raw supplier response** Field: `Book response (EK 409 BYP-A0001) / orphan GDS PNR`. Expected: Book succeeds for a confirmed offer, or fails cleanly without leaving a supplier-side PNR or exposing the raw reply. **Impact:** 3 of 8 EK Book attempts in a repeat test failed; each failure leaves an orphan GDS PNR (CancelAfterHold with gdsPNR only returns 500) and exposes supplier data Evidence: EK-07 V1 DXB-DEL, EK-10 V1 and V2 CAI-JED (offers 1815 AED, 28/28 itemized); repeat test V1 CAI-JED, V2 CAI-JED, V1 DXB-DEL failed, V2 DXB-DEL x2, V1 DXB-DEL, V2/V1 CAI-JED passed; orphan GDS PNRs listed in Cleanup
- **[TC-BOOK-POS-01] BUG-19 (new) &mdash; Retrieve does not echo what was booked for an infant: parentPaxRefId, nationality and residentCountry come back null (V1 and V2), the contactRefId is replaced by travelerRefId_N and names are upper-cased** Field: `passengersList[].parentPaxRefId / nationality / residentCountry (Retrieve)`. Expected: INF passenger with parentPaxRefId resolving to the ADT and the submitted nationality/residentCountry. **Impact:** The infant-to-adult link cannot be verified after booking; downstream systems lose passenger data Evidence: ADT+INF QR CAI-JED: V1 and V2 Retrieve INF entry {"parentPaxRefId":null,"nationality":null,"residentCountry":null,"contactRefId":"travelerRefId_2","name":"LINA IBRAHIM"}
- **[TC-TPNREG-HOLD-01] BUG-20 (new) &mdash; holdExpirationDate for the same flight differs by two hours between versions: V1 returns 2026-11-04T20:59:00Z while V2 returns 2026-11-04T20:59:00+02:00** Field: `holdExpirationDate`. Expected: The same instant and the same UTC-offset convention on V1 and V2. **Impact:** A client computing hold expiry from V2 sees the hold last two hours less than V1 reports, so BookAfterHold may be attempted late or cleanup scheduled wrongly Evidence: Hold on QR DOH-DXB (same flight) V1 vs V2; all 13 V1 holds end in Z and all 12 V2 holds in +02:00
- **[TC-TPNREG-RTE-SRCH-SV-01] BUG-21 (new) &mdash; Saudia (SV) returns no offers for TravelportNdc/UAE on any of 30 routes (JED, RUH, DMM, MED, AHB hubs and regional routes) on V1 or V2, on 4 different dates; the preferredAirlines=SV filter also returns an empty offers[]** Field: `Search offers (supplier TravelportNdc, preferredAirlines SV)`. Expected: SV offers on its domestic and international routes, like QR, EK and RJ. **Impact:** One of the four airlines named for this regression cannot be searched or booked, so no SV flow can run Evidence: 60 empty route/version results; CAP-02 SV 0 of 4 routes; SV never appears as a marketing carrier in any of the 318 sweep searches. Confirm whether SV is expected on TravelportNdc/UAE (credentials or distribution setup)
- **[TC-SEARCH-BND-01] BUG-22 (new) &mdash; Search for 10 passengers counting infants (6 ADT + 2 CHD + 2 INF) returns HTTP 200 with an empty offers[] on V1 and V2 instead of a validation error, while 10 seated passengers (ADT+CHD) are rejected with 400** Field: `passengers[] (Search validation)`. Expected: 400 standard validation envelope naming passengers (combined cap of 9, SPEC 2.1). **Impact:** The caller cannot tell an over-limit party from "no availability"; every combination with ADT+CHD+INF above 9 silently returns nothing Evidence: V1 and V2: 6A+2C+2I 200 offers 0; 9-passenger control 5A+2C+2I returns offers; TC-TPNREG-PAX-NEG-04/05 (10 ADT, 9 ADT+1 CHD) return 400; the first passenger-search pass showed 200/empty for every combination above 9 with infants
- **[TC-TPNREG-PAX-NEG-01] BUG-23 (new) &mdash; Search accepts a party of one child with no adult (200, 53 offers) on V1 and V2** Field: `passengers[] (child without adult)`. Expected: 400 validation error, or a documented unaccompanied-minor rule (an adult is required to book). **Impact:** Offers are priced for a party that cannot be booked; the failure only appears later at Book/AddPassenger Evidence: passengers [{CHD,1}]: V1 200 53 offers, V2 200 53 offers. Business rule needs confirmation (SPEC only states the 9-passenger cap)
- **[FLOW-V2-25-NEG] BUG-24 (new) &mdash; V2 FareConfirm accepts a ResponseId created by a Search under credentialsSelector UAE when called with credentialsSelector EGY (200 with an offer), while supplier=SabreNdc and credentialsSelector=KSA are rejected** Field: `FareConfirm (credentialsSelector vs ResponseId)`. Expected: 4xx: the ResponseId does not belong to the credentialsSelector used in the call. **Impact:** Credential context is not enforced across the chain: an offer found under one tenant can be confirmed (and then booked) under another Evidence: V2 FareConfirm with credentialsSelector=EGY: 200 selectedOffer; SabreNdc and KSA variants rejected with 4xx
- **[FLOW-V2-26-NEG] BUG-25 (new) &mdash; V2 Hold accepts a mismatched AddPassenger id pair (responseId of AddPassenger A with offerId of AddPassenger B) and creates a held booking** Field: `Hold (fareConfirmResponseId / selectedOfferId pair)`. Expected: 4xx: the offerId does not belong to the responseId, no PNR created. **Impact:** A stale or crossed id pair books an unintended offer; the held PNR must be cancelled by hand Evidence: V2 Hold returned 200 pnr 82FNT5 (tickets none); cancelled in cleanup. V1 Book with a mismatched offer/response pair is rejected with 400 (FLOW-V1-01-NEG)
- **[FLOW-V2-75-NEG] BUG-26 (new) &mdash; V2 AddPassenger accepts the pre-Upselling Search ids instead of the substituted upSelling ids (200)** Field: `AddPassenger (ResponseId / selectedOfferId)`. Expected: 4xx or a clear indication that the Upselling tier was not applied. **Impact:** A client that forgets the substitution silently books the original fare, not the chosen tier Evidence: AddPassenger with the Search ResponseId/selectedOfferId after an Upselling call: 200 offerId returned; control with the Upselling ids also 200
- **[TC-TPNREG-PAX-BNEG-05] BUG-27 (new) &mdash; Passenger age is not validated against passenger type: a child declared with an adult birth date and an infant declared with a 5-year-old birth date pass AddPassenger and V1 Book validation; the supplier rejects at Book with an unmapped 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 that names an orphan GDS PNR and carries the raw supplier reply** Field: `passengersList[].birthDate vs passengerTypeCode`. Expected: 400 validation error naming the birth date / passenger type at AddPassenger or Book, no supplier-side PNR. **Impact:** Bad age data creates supplier-side PNRs that the API cannot cancel and surfaces as an unmapped error Evidence: PAX-BNEG-05 (CHD born 1990-01-01) and PAX-BNEG-06 (INF born 2021-06-01): V1 Book 409 Z9999, V2 AddPassenger 200 then Book 409 Z9999, orphan GDS PNRs JJ0R4Y, JJ0R4Z, JJ0R50, JJ0R52 and the re-run pair
- **[TC-SEARCH-BIZ-01] BUG-28 (new) &mdash; Search offers carry empty taxesAndFees while paxTotalTaxAmount is non-zero: all QR and RJ offers tested (0 of 20 on CAI-JED, 0 of 5 on DOH-DXB, 0 of 3 RJ on AMM-DXB itemized) and 25 of 53 mixed offers, so the SPEC 2.1 reconciliation (items = paxTotalTaxAmount) fails; FareConfirm and Book are itemized** Field: `offers[].passengerFareBreakdown[].taxesAndFees`. Expected: taxesAndFees summing to paxTotalTaxAmount on every offer. **Impact:** Tax breakdown is unavailable at search time for most offers Evidence: V1 Search 2 ADT + 2 CHD + 2 INF CAI-JED: 25 of 53 offers fail (INF/ADT/CHD tax items 0 != paxTotalTaxAmount); first observed 2026-08-05 (29 of 67 offers)
- **[TC-TPNREG-RTE-SRCH-RJ-02] BUG-29 (new) &mdash; Intermittent HTTP 500 ServerError on Search: V1 AMM-RUH and V2 AMM-LHR (RJ filter) returned 500 once each during the parallel run, with V1 and V2 offer counts disagreeing for those routes** Field: `Search (HTTP 500 ServerError)`. Expected: 200 with offers on every request. **Impact:** A valid Search fails with no cause; callers need retries Evidence: 2 of more than 1,000 Searches while three stages ran in parallel; 24 sequential repeats of the same two routes on V1 and V2 all returned 200 (AMM-RUH 4 offers, AMM-LHR 1 offer), so it is load-related and not reproduced in isolation

- **[TC-ADDPAX-VAL-01]** AddPassenger rejects a party that differs from Search with 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 ("The total number of adult passengers must match the number of adults in the search request"); an infant with a missing, unknown or child parent gets "Invalid infant to adult reference"; an unresolved contactRefId gets "Passenger without valid contact reference"; non-Latin names are rejected ("Passenger name must contain alphabetic characters only", minimum 2 characters); two passengers with the same name and birth date get "Duplicate passengers detected" Evidence: TC-ADDPAX-NEG-01/02, VAL-01, BND-01, TC-TPNREG-PAX-BNEG-01..04, 07, 08 (V2 AddPassenger and V1 Book use the same rules, V1 with more explicit Context text)
- **[FLOW-V1-01-NEG]** Book with an offerId from another Search (stale-ID substitution) is rejected with HTTP 400 and no PNR on V1 (via FareConfirm and via Upselling); the ErrorCode is now NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 "Invalid request. Please check the request parameters and try again.", not ValidationError as recorded on 2026-08-05 Evidence: FLOW-V1-01-NEG, 03-NEG, 07-NEG, 09-NEG on 2026-11-01
- **[TC-VOIDTPN-VAL-03]** Void requires gdsPNR: gdsPNR "" or omitted returns 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 "GdsPnr is required" on V1 and V2; voidTickets null returns 400 (code 1001, "The VoidTickets field is required"), voidTickets omitted voids all tickets Evidence: VAL-03, VAL-06 and TC-VOID-NEG-01 on 2026-11-01
- **[TC-CANCELHOLD-NEG-01]** V2 CancelAfterHold sent with the unquoted credentialsSelector (invalid JSON) is rejected server-side with HTTP 400, ErrorCode 1001 ("The cancelAfterHoldRequestDto field is required. / 'U' is an invalid start of a value"); V2 Hold with credentialsSelector empty or the literal placeholder gets 400 1001 "The holdRequestDto field is required" Evidence: TC-CANCELHOLD-NEG-01 and TC-HOLD-NEG-01 on 2026-11-01
- **[TC-SEARCH-BND-01]** Search party-size behaviour: ADT+CHD above 9 (10 ADT, 9 ADT + 1 CHD) returns 400 on V1 and V2; a party above 9 only because of infants returns 200 with an empty offers[]; an infant-only party, more infants than adults, count 0, a negative count, an unknown passengerTypeCode, an empty passengers[] and a duplicated ADT entry are rejected with 400; a child-only party is accepted Evidence: TC-TPNREG-PAX-NEG-01..10 and TC-SEARCH-BND-01
- **[TC-VOIDTPN-POS-03]** The QR hold deadline (holdExpirationDate) is 2026-11-04 for a 2026-11-12 flight, three days after the run, so post-expiry cases can only be run from 2026-11-05; Hold -&gt; FareConfirmAfterHold -&gt; BookAfterHold keeps pnr, gdsPNR and bookingToken unchanged and issues one ticket per passenger on V1 and V2 Evidence: FLOW-V1-04/05/10/11, FLOW-V2-28/29/76/77 and TC-VOIDTPN-POS-03

### Not reproduced

- **BUG-14** (Transient Emirates errors as unmapped Z9999) &mdash; exercised by FLOW-V2-76-TPN, TC-VOIDTPN-POS-03. No "RESERVATION UPDATE IN PROGRESS" or "NO RESPONSE FROM VENDOR" error appeared this run (every hold-to-ticket flow ran on QR). The EK Book failures are a different symptom (BUG-18).
- **BUG-02** (V1 Void unsupported (409 OperationNotSupported)) &mdash; exercised by TC-CAPCHECK-TPN-03, TC-VOIDTPN-POS-01. V1 Void succeeds (fixed since Round 2).
- **BUG-07** (Whitespace-only pnr voids the booking) &mdash; exercised by TC-VOIDTPN-BND-01. Whitespace-only pnr and bookingToken and a 256-character pnr are rejected with 400.
- **BUG-08** (Void on a held booking cancels the hold) &mdash; exercised by TC-VOIDTPN-BIZ-03. Void on a held booking is rejected (409 Z9999 "booking is on hold and not ticketed") and the hold survives; the code is still the unmapped Z9999.
